text: When we are anxious, we begin to walk faster, and such a gait in turn gives the brain a signal of “danger,” increasing stress. So - you can use this pattern in a slightly unusual way. Try literally 5-10 minutes of walking in a mode of conscious calmness: your step slightly slower than usual, the foot placed fully (heel–middle–toes), step width - average, comfortable. Breathe through your nose, gaze - into the distance. You will notice that the nervous system switches into safety mode. This is bodily psychotherapy: you consciously change your gait, and this changes your state.
